name: redline
description: A tachometer for your Claude sessions: when the needle hits the redline, stop spawning and start finishing.

statusLine.title: Show the count at the bottom of the terminal
statusLine.description: The status line is the thin bar along the bottom of your terminal. true puts the stage and your session count there, e.g. "Idling · 1/7". false leaves the bottom alone; the gauge above your prompt says the same thing either way.

fuelGauge.title: Show the fuel gauges
fuelGauge.description: true adds three small dials beside the tachometer: 5H and 7D for your plan's five-hour and weekly rate-limit windows, and CTX for this session's context. Each needle travels from F (full) to E (empty) as its tank is used, with a red reserve at the E end. The plan dials need a subscription; CTX works for everyone. A dial with no reading stays dim. false keeps the tachometer alone.
